sections.heading: Proposal Summary
sections.text: This proposal, SYN-SYNCP000180-P1, was presented by the Supplier to Blue Ridge Medical Group 180 on March 8, 2025.

sections.heading: Supplier Concession
sections.text: Supplier concession: a Tier 1 rebate of 3%.

sections.heading: Supplier Request
sections.text: Supplier request: a Tdap share floor of 80%.

sections.heading: Proposal Status
sections.text: Status of this proposal: declined by the Customer.
